user_query: I want to improve my writing skills by understanding the most important terms in a given text. Can you extract the key terms from the following text: 'Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit'? The text is in Italian.

TaskList.description: Identify the language of the provided text to ensure proper processing.
Translate the text from Italian to a language suitable for analysis if necessary.
Extract the key terms or important words from the translated text to help improve writing skills.
